title: A secretary for Messrs. Luce and Mallows
summary: We analyze the secretary problem in the case that the $n$ ranked items arrive not in uniformly random order but rather according to a certain type of Luce distribution or according to a Mallows distribution on the set $S_n$ of permutations of $[n]$. The secretary problem for the Mallows distributions with parameter $q\in(0,1)$ was analyzed in a previous paper; in this paper the case $q>1$ is also analyzed.
